title: JWT Verifier with Key Rotation
instructions: Implement `JwtCodec` and `require_scopes` in `jwt_lite.py` using only the standard library (`Unauthorized`, `Forbidden` and `Principal` are given). `issue` signs HS256 tokens with the active `kid`; `verify` pins the algorithm, selects the key by `kid`, compares signatures in constant time and validates `iss`, `aud`, `exp` and `nbf` with optional leeway, raising `Unauthorized` with a short reason. `require_scopes` raises `Forbidden` (403) for missing scopes.

evidence.label: Issues compact unpadded HS256 tokens with the expected header and claims, and verifies them
Rejects tampered payloads (signature), alg none/HS512 (alg) and garbage (malformed)
Rejects non-object headers/claims and invalid JSON as malformed
Checks issuer and audience, accepting aud as a string or a list
Reports "missing <claim>" for each of sub, iss, aud, exp and iat
Rejects expired tokens and applies leeway to exp
Rejects tokens used before nbf, applying leeway
Verifies retired-but-configured keys, fails with kid once removed, and checks each kid against its own key
require_scopes raises Forbidden listing missing scopes sorted; Forbidden is not Unauthorized
Rejects an unknown active_kid; Principal is frozen and ignores claims in equality
